title: Vikram and Betal: The Honest Answer Test
moral: Be honest, even when no one is watching.

scenes.summary: Betal tells a story about a teacher’s test.
scenes.text: Betal told Vikram about a teacher testing honesty.
scenes.image_prompt: vikram carrying betal in forest cartoon style

scenes.text: The teacher told students to eat fruit where no one could see them.
scenes.image_prompt: teacher giving fruit to students cartoon

scenes.summary: Students return after completing the task.
scenes.text: Most students said they had eaten the fruit.
scenes.image_prompt: students returning and speaking to teacher cartoon

scenes.summary: One student does not eat the fruit.
scenes.text: One student said he could always see himself.
scenes.image_prompt: student holding fruit and explaining cartoon

scenes.text: The teacher praised the honest student. Vikram answered wisely, and Betal flew away.
scenes.image_prompt: teacher praising student while others watch cartoon

story: A student refused to eat fruit secretly because he believed he is always watching himself. Vikram said true honesty comes from within.
